title: Gammatone Filter Bank
text: Extract mel-frequency cepstral coefficients from audio, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Filter bank normalization} sets Normalization technique for filter bank; {Window} sets the analysis window hamming, {Overlap length} sets the number of overlapping samples between adjacent, {Number of cepstral coefficients}, {Rectification} sets the type of nonlinear, {Append delta}, {Append delta-delta}, {Delta window length} sets the number of coefficients for calculating delta, {Number of feature vectors} sets the number of MFCC feature vectors in output, {Number of overlapped feature vectors} sets the number of feature vectors overlapped, {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the source of input sample rate, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate, {Number of bands}, {Auto-determine frequency range} sets the automatically determine frequency range, {Frequency range (Hz)} sets the frequency range of mel filter bank, {Filter bank design domain} sets the design domain of mel filter, {Mel style}, {Normalize window} sets the normalize analysis window, {Spectrum type} sets the type of spectrum, {Auto-determine FFT length} sets the automatically determine FFT length and {FFT length} sets the number of DFT points. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Window
params.values: Analysis window hamming(1024,’periodic’) (default) | real vector

params.name: Overlap length
params.values: Number of overlapping samples between adjacent windows 512 (default) | integer in the range [0, windowLength )

params.name: Number of cepstral coefficients
params.values: Number of cepstral coefficients in each feature vector 13 (default) | positive integer greater than 1

params.name: Rectification
params.values: Type of nonlinear rectification Logarithm (default) | Cubic root

params.name: Append delta
params.values: Append delta of MFCCs to feature vectors on (default) | off

params.name: Append delta-delta
params.values: Append delta-delta of MFCCs to feature vectors on (default) | off

params.name: Delta window length
params.values: Number of coefficients for calculating delta and delta-delta 9 (default) | odd integer greater than 2

params.name: Number of feature vectors
params.values: Number of MFCC feature vectors in output 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of overlapped feature vectors
params.values: Number of feature vectors overlapped in output 0 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: Specify source of input sample rate off (default) | on

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input 44.1e3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Number of bands
params.values: Number of bands in mel filter bank 32 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Auto-determine frequency range
params.values: Automatically determine frequency range on (default) | off

params.name: Frequency range (Hz)
params.values: Frequency range of mel filter bank [0,22050] (default) | two-element row vector

params.name: Filter bank design domain
params.values: Design domain of mel filter bank linear (default) | warped

params.name: Filter bank normalization
params.values: Normalization technique for filter bank bandwidth (default) | area | none

params.name: Mel style
params.values: Mel style oshaughnessy (default) | slaney

params.name: Normalize window
params.values: Normalize analysis window on (default) | off

params.name: Spectrum type
params.values: Type of spectrum power (default) | magnitude

params.name: Auto-determine FFT length
params.values: Automatically determine FFT length on (default) | off

params.name: FFT length
params.values: Number of DFT points 1024 (default) | positive integer
